hints.title: Backward Collection
hints.text: Operations remove elements from the right end of nums one by one.

hints.title: Collection Set
hints.text: Collect elements that are between 1 and k into a hash set.

hints.title: Stop Condition
hints.text: The moment the set contains all integers 1..k (size equals k), return the number of operations performed.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: k: number of distinct elements to collect
complexity.notes: Single reverse scan with small set.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Reverse traversal is already linear and optimal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Scan from right to left tracking collected integers.
